digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API / external live tests
propositions: The public rebar.llm.review_ticket() API was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external test modules still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 live CI lanes.

The removal epic's migration scope covered 17 of 19 internal test files but missed two external modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) because external tests are excluded from the standard Verified gate.
review_plan (the original retarget candidate) returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT without a top-level findings field, making it incompatible with both tests' assertions for result["findings"].
Both external modules were successfully retargeted to review_code (which returns REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings) with adapted test names and schema contracts matching the surviving API.
